His vehicle was recovered from a parking lot in the vicinity of his work place at Woodbridge Mall (Hwy 7/Martingrove, Woodbridge, Ontario) on the 11th of February 2002, having been parked there for approximately 6-9 months. Istefan has not been in contact with any family members nor his employers since he left his home on the morning of June 30, 2001. Case reference: 2014004588.CaseDesc: On November 23, 1986, Pierre-Jean Durocher was last seen at a rooming house in Longueuil, Quebec. Pierre-Jean was reported missing on November 25, 1986, by a family member. Pierre-Jean's backpack containing his identification was later found on the Jacques Cartier Bridge in Montreal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2025030773.CaseDesc: John Edwards was last seen at around 16:00 on 11 June 2025, leaving St. Joseph's Villa in Dundas, Ontario. He was walking south on Milgrove Side Road, heading away from Highway 6 in Flamborough. The distance from this location to the villa is approximately 10.3 km. John has cognitive impairments resembling dementia and is considered vulnerable. Due to the unpredictability of his movements and the recent heatwave, the police are extremely concerned for his safety. There is currently no evidence of foul play, and the Hamilton Police Service is appealing to the public and businesses for CCTV and dash cam footage.

Case reference: 2026000991.CaseDesc: On 2 August 2025, Nelson Boudreau and Gregory Landry set sail from Havre-Saint-Pierre, in Quebec, aboard a 24-foot Dorval boat, with the aim of fishing east of Havre-Saint-Pierre. The subsequent investigation revealed that debris from the boat had been found in the area between La Romaine and Chevery.

Tattoo: Back Of Neck, Tiger and Foliage

Case reference: 2022037048.CaseDesc: On June 20, 2008, the body of an unidentified man was recovered from Lake Erie, approximately one mile off the north end of Woodlawn Beach in Buffalo, New York.

Jacket: Dark Blue, Brand: Carhartt; size: small

Blue, Pullover sweater; brand: Mountain Expedition

Case reference: 2014001575.CaseDesc: On March 12, 1983, Samuel Amos Quatell was reported missing from the fishing vessel “ISE II”, near Steep Island, BC. Steep Island is located near Seymour Narrows; between Quadra Island and Campbell River, BC. Samuel was last seen near the rear of the vessel, by the ship’s crew.  An extensive search failed to locate Samuel. The tidal currents near the island are extremely strong and any person in the water could travel a great distance in a short period of time.

Amputation: Left Hand, Missing tip of ring finger

Case reference: 2014005451.CaseDesc: John W. Burton and two passengers (Clifford Dowson and Edward Flett) were flying from Oxford House to Island Lake in Manitoba. John Burton was the pilot of the Cessna 185 and at approximately 11:00 a.m. he made a routine radio call stating that the plane would be landing at Garden Hill in approximately 15 minutes. The plane never arrived at its destination. The wreckage and all three souls on board were never located.

Case reference: 2014004566.CaseDesc: On September 14, 1981, at approximately 5:00pm, Dennis Krioul was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Dennis’ wife states that he was in some business trouble and he had a warrant out for his arrest for fraud.

Case reference: 2014003365.CaseDesc: At approximately 2:00 p.m. on October 30, 1982, Daniel Christensen left the family cabin near Long Lake in Manitoba. He took the family dog with him and intended to go chicken hunting. His family reported him missing the next day.  On November 6, 1982, the dog returned to the cabin in good health. Daniel has never been located.

Case reference: 2012020056.CaseDesc: Sylvia Ann Guiboche was last seen around mid June 2003.  Sylvia is known to frequent the Sargent Avenue/Ellice Avenue area of Winnipeg, Manitoba.  Sylvia is at high risk of being exploited.

Other: Abdomen, Was 6-9 months pregnant at time of disappearance

Case reference: 2014005318.CaseDesc: In November of 1983, Tony Spalancin was seen for the last time leaving his place of employment in Drayton Valley, Alberta. It is believed that Tony travelled to Calgary, Alberta, to seek new employment. His vehicle was later located in Calgary.
